request.subject: UNIT:CULT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Redraw it as another member of the same society in the same blue robe, burly and square with big broad shoulders: the hood is short with a small point; a broad pale cream sash crosses the chest with one round brass medal; one hand holds a huge polished brass cleaver low; the other arm is raised straight up with one finger pointing at the sky. No candle and no scroll. Keep the two cream eyes, the slippers, the thick black outline and the art style, on a transparent background.
